VERIFICATION REPORT (round 2 of 3)
1. Tool-call integrity: YES. All commands (cat, grep, sed, python3, echo) ran successfully without errors or truncation affecting the final result.
2. Statute coverage: YES. Section 3306(a)(2)(B) retrieved at lines 251-350 via sed -n '251,350p' showing the 10 days/5 individuals requirement.
3. Grounded reasoning: YES. All figures (5 individuals, 10 days, agricultural labor) trace to statute text at lines 271-273 of the sed output.
4. Provision selection and application: YES. Solver correctly matched §3306(a)(2)(B) to agricultural labor facts and verified all 12 employment dates had 5+ workers.
5. Tool-assisted computation: YES. Step 6 ran python3 with datetime.isocalendar() to count 11 different calendar weeks, confirming the prose analysis.
